rationale: This study examines how Norwegian authorities and street-level bureaucrats socialise voluntary immigrant organisations into formal bureaucratic structures and Norwegian administrative culture. It is completely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access (fails Criterion 1 and Criterion 4; excluded under E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Although the article examines street-level bureaucrats, written organisational statutes and administrative culture generally, it has no connection to water or sanitation services, so the record is excluded under both the narrow rule-type and plain Criterion 2 readings (E01).

evidence_quotes.quote: This article analyses the way Norwegian authorities facilitate and expect immigrant organisations to serve as schools of democracy
while in practice street-level bureaucrats educate members of immigrant organisations in how to establish and run a formal, hierarchical, rule-based and impersonal organisation in Norway.
